thread:
Ana S.: Ok team — we need to lock down the audit event taxonomy and the customer-facing validation rules before next week's release. Proposed scope: coverage matrix for RBAC changes, KMS key ops, token lifecycle events, and model-routing/fallback events. Also: schema versioning + a small CI validator. Any objections?

Kevin L.: SG. Can we map to existing event types first? I put an initial mapping in the doc: https://go/internal/audit-taxonomy-draft — mostly reusing, but there are gaps for `fallback` and `quota` events.

Maya R.: +1 on reuse, but we should standardize an `outcome` enum (success | failure | denied | fallback) and an `actor_type` field (user | service | system). Example minimal payload we should validate against:
```json
{"event_type":"auth.token.rotate","timestamp":"2026-06-03T12:34:56Z","actor_id":"svc-123","actor_type":"service","outcome":"success","details":{}}
```

Devin P.: Quick question on customer-facing events: what PII / secrets are permitted? We must not leak ARN/key ids or raw tokens. My take: allow `key_alias` (e.g. "alias/redwood-prod") but redact/mask key ids. Also forbid embedding raw `request_body` if it may contain secrets.

Kevin L.: Agreed. For RBAC changes we should include `change_set` as an array of {op, resource, role_before, role_after} but ensure the `principal_email` is allowed only if the customer opted into detailed audit exports. Otherwise mask to `user:xxxx`.

audit-bot: CI validator available at https://ci.internal/redwood/audit-validator — run `make audit-validate` or CI job `audit/schema-check`. It supports `--schema-version` and will return non-zero on schema drift.

Ana S.: Action items: 1) Kevin — update taxonomy spreadsheet with the `outcome` & `actor_type` columns and the RBAC change_set shape (due Tue EOD). 2) Maya — open PR to add `outcome` + `actor_type` to canonical schema and add examples for KMS events. 3) Devin — draft redaction rules for customer-facing exports (masking examples + allowed fields). 4) I'll schedule a cross-team sync (security, infra, product) Thu 11am to sign-off and agree on export defaults.

Maya R.: I'll include a sample redaction table in the PR.

Devin P.: I'll draft a short customer-facing FAQ about what we log and how we redact.

Ana S.: Perfect. If anyone wants to sneak in other event types (quota, model-fallback) add them to the sheet; otherwise we'll gate on Thu. :thumbsup:
